methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: In a literature review context, this paper examines the flexible OPC UA standard, particularly concerning its applicability to energy monitoring.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Tool/software and interoperability study without an identifiable or characterisable EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: We demonstrate, in a quick case study, a CPS’ prototypical implementation by transforming a power meter (Modbus RTU over RS485) into a CPS sensor compatible with a distributed EMS.

stage1.notes: EnPIs are mentioned only as outputs consuming production or economic data; no EnPI/EnB functional form, model construction, or estimation approach is presented.
